question: Does explicit provider 4.1.1 versus the current default 4.1.2 alter GPU/context costs on one unchanged driver?
analysis: Equal-weight paired process means, default minus explicit 4.1.1. Two-sided 95% Student t intervals are descriptive; no speed gate or adaptive sample selection.
stopping: Exactly eight balanced pairs, no pilot, trimming, early success or optional extension. Check the primary allowance before each child; incomplete evidence cannot pass. Build/debug controls and bounded child completion are outside that allowance.
limits: C++ only, maximum render SDR at 1080p, same current driver. Initial provider identity verified per process; warm creations reuse the same immutable override chain. No driver rollback, Rust overhead requalification, image-quality, throughput or universal parity claim. Provider outputs need not be byte-identical across arms.
